_comment: Copy to ~/.config/signal-listener/config.json and edit. The ACI is the ONLY authentication — Signal validates it cryptographically. Phone numbers are display attributes and are never used to authorize.
_freshness_note: Messages older than this are answered with a notice instead of acted on, so a backlog cannot replay after downtime.
_throttle_note: Burst cooldown, not an hourly cap. A cap punishes normal conversation and fails silently; a cooldown only reacts to a genuine flood, always announces itself, and clears on its own.
_model_note: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. These are free-tier models; set key_file to a file containing the API key, mode 600.
_timeout_note: Generous on purpose. A typing indicator runs while the model works, so a slow answer looks like thinking rather than a hang. Short timeouts silently queued real questions. Never set a max_tokens: reasoning models emit reasoning before content, and any cap risks an empty reply.
_steps_note: Agent loop budget. The model chooses read-only steps (search / open a page / server probe / weather) until it can answer. Bounded because each step costs a round trip, and because a query composed after reading fetched text is a channel injected content could try to steer.
_monthly_review_note: Who runs the monthly review. 'local' = this machine does it itself (one-device setup). 'remote' = a second machine with a full agent owns it, so this one stays quiet rather than sending a second, contradictory report. 'off' = no review.
_site_note: How the assistant describes the machine it lives on, and where its home-directory probes look.
_services_note: How to check each service. type: user | system | port. Getting this wrong reports healthy services as dead — a user service checked as a system service always looks inactive, and anything in a container may have no service entry at all, only a listening port. unit defaults to the service name.
_allowed_units_note: Restartable units. Keep to user units unless the account has passwordless sudo — listing units it cannot touch only produces confusing failures.
_allowed_jobs_note: Named commands the owner may re-run by typing 'rerun <name>'. Never reachable from free text or from a model.
_custom_commands_note: Extra read-only commands for this host, typed exactly or reached by a synonym. show_unit pairs the output with a service state check.
_custom_probes_note: Extra probes the agent may name while answering. Same safety boundary as the built-ins: the model emits a NAME and the code decides what it runs, so a name that is not defined here is dropped.
